title: Blunt fingers and a psychiatrist's remark
summary: Hall tells of a psychiatrist who thought his blunt fingers meant he should be dead, and discusses finger shape and key spacing.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians
